mapper.select: select vh.*, COALESCE(( select count(*) from user_collect uc where uc.target_type = 'homestay' and uc.target_id = CAST(vh.id AS CHAR) ), 0) as collect_number, -- is_collect 表示"当前用户是否收藏过"，依赖传入的 userId CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_collect uc2 WHERE uc2.user_id = #{userId} AND uc2.target_type = 'homestay' AND uc2.target_id = CAST(vh.id AS CHAR) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_collect from village_homestay vh where vh.id = #{id}
select * from village_homestay where village_id = #{villageId} order by id desc
select id, village_name as villageName from village order by id asc
